title: Understanding the Pivot Table
text: To create the DataFrame q1g, you need to use a pivot table to summarize the data. Think about which columns should be used as the index, columns, and values in the pivot table.

title: Choosing the Right Columns
text: Consider using $$'is_{reachable'}$$ as the index and 'item' as the columns. This will help you organize the data by reachability and fruit type.

title: Calculating the Average
text: The pivot table should calculate the average inventory for each combination of 'item' and $$'is_{reachable'}$$. Use the 'aggfunc' parameter to specify this calculation.
